summary: I sent the bounded brief with no visual cues. The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and read NOTES.md, the page files and all four UI guideline docs. It went through two auto-compactions, then read visual-companion.md. It called this a bounded change that would stay in chat, ran start-server.sh, gave me a localhost URL with a key, and wrote filter-placement.html showing three layouts (A filter bar, B popover, C side panel), recommending A. I picked A. It then asked its non-visual follow-up questions in the terminal (which filters, no-JS handling, token sheet) and posted a short design in chat with "I'll start only after you say yes." I approved, and it began implementation work. No spec file and no plan document were created.
reasoning: All 8 criteria are backed by the session log and the files on disk. The agent worked out on its own that the layout question was better shown than described, even though the brief had no visual cues and compaction happened between the skill load and the question. It opened the companion only when that question came up, kept everything else in the terminal, held the bounded path with no spec and no plan, got approval before writing code, and then started implementing.

observations.description: On the workspace trust and Bypass Permissions startup dialogs, the cursor starts on "No, exit", so it takes Down+Enter to get past each one. This is expected but easy to fumble.

The agent raised a .gitignore housekeeping point (the .hyperpowers/ brainstorm folder is untracked and should be ignored) without being asked. This was reasonable and it correctly didn't act without approval, but the companion leaving untracked artifacts in the repo is worth noting.

Auto-compaction happened twice during the brainstorm phase (log compact_boundary at 13:49:29 and 13:50:14) and again just after approval. The four long guideline docs fill the context quickly. The skill was restored after compaction ("Skills restored (hyperpowers:brainstorming)").
After compaction, the agent re-read large parts of the guidelines with sed/grep before implementing. That's thorough, but it re-uses a lot of context and brings on another compaction.
The companion message warns "The browser view uses a lot of tokens, so tell me if you'd rather stay in the terminal." The opt-out is a nice touch.

criteria.evidence: Screen: "⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill" as the first action. In the session log, grep for skill names returns only '1 "skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"'.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened: start-server.sh run, localhost URL given, HTML screen of candidate layouts written
criteria.evidence: Log Bash call: ".../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir \"$PWD\" --open". Then a Write to .hyperpowers/brainstorm/6366-1790949019/content/filter-placement.html containing "A: Filter bar above the table" and other options. Screen: "I've sketched three options in a browser tab... http://localhost:62264/?key=0ee1829f..."

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time, not upfront; non-visual questions not routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: Order of tool calls in the log: Skill, reading notes, page files and guidelines, Read visual-companion.md, start-server, Write filter-placement.html. The companion was not mentioned before the layout question came up. After my pick it wrote waiting.html ("Continuing in terminal..."). The non-visual questions ("Which filters should the bar include?", No-JS handling, Token sheet) were asked as terminal AskUserQuestion prompts.
Screen: "I'm treating this as a bounded change... So the design will be short and stay in this chat, with no spec file or plan document, and nothing gets built until you approve it."
`ls docs/superpowers docs/hyperpowers` returned "No such file or directory" for both. `git status --short` shows only "?? .hyperpowers/" (the brainstorm screens).

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: The only Skill invocation in the log is hyperpowers:brainstorming. `ls docs/plans` returned "No such file or directory". The design and commit outline were given in chat only.

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval of chosen layout before writing implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "I recommend A... Have a look and tell me what you think here." Later the design summary ended with "Does this look right? I'll start only after you say yes." No source files were modified before my approval (git status clean apart from .hyperpowers/).

After "Yes, looks right. Go ahead." the screen shows "Status: specs re-read for the controls I'm using. Checking whether the field width tokens (sm/md/lg) have defined values." and further guideline greps for the implementation. When I stopped observing, a second compaction was in progress and no files had been written yet.
